EmailTemplate.name: Sanford: Online Soc MA Program Info
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the online Sociology program at ASU!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in the Online Sociology Master’s Program at the T. Denny Sanford School of Social and Family Dynamics! Please review the program handbook for information on program procedures, policy, courses offered, timelines and more.
This program has a rolling admissions policy and students are admitted as applications are received. Please visit the program’s website for more information regarding the program.
Submit your application today.
Please email me any questions about the application or program.
Thank you and we look forward to hearing from you!
Gina Perez, M.Ed. Graduate Programs Coordinator T. Denny Sanford School of Social and Family Dynamics {!Case.Thread_Id}
